title: Rate Note: Platform Fee Amount for the Month a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Closes
content:
**Rate clause.** The platform fee for the closing month of a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is the monthly platform fee of the tier the service holds on the closing date, billed for the whole month and booked as one platform fee entry for that billing month that points to no source entry, rounded half up to the cent.

The closing month is the calendar month in which the closing date falls, and the monthly platform fee is the figure of the tariff for the tier held on that date.

**How the amount is put together.** The closing-month fee is that monthly platform fee multiplied by every multiplier that applies to the closing month, and then reduced once by the sum of every percentage that applies to it, the percentages being added together into one rate rather than applied one after another; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and a fee that comes to zero is not debited.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tariff amounts)

1. A tier whose monthly platform fee were 60.00, closing on any day of a month: the closing-month platform fee is 60.00, billed for the whole month, one platform fee entry for that month with no source entry.
2. The same 60.00 with a multiplier of 0.6 and percentages of 7 and 4: 60.00 multiplied by 0.6 is 36.00; the two percentages make one rate of 11 percent; 36.00 reduced by 11 percent is 32.04.
3. A monthly platform fee of 47.00 with a multiplier of 0.6 and one rate of 11 percent: 47.00 multiplied by 0.6 is 28.20, reduced by 11 percent is 25.098, and rounding once at the end gives 25.10.
4. A tier whose monthly platform fee is 0.00 gives a closing-month fee of zero, which is not debited.
